pages.text: Sync grows 5%% a minute while you ride; on the first climb, each ring you hit adds 3%%. A body moves its own way from the first second: a flier flies, a spider climbs, a chicken floats. At 25%% its other traits work.
At 50%% $(k:key.headinajar.ability) fires its ability, at 75%% $(k:key.headinajar.secondary) the second (blaze, enderman, ravager). At 100%%: 10%% stronger.
